programmes.d: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's putting out a fire on a houseboat and escaping a box of bugs submerged underwater.
Contestants are dunked by a helicopter, transport disgusting items from a conveyor belt, and fight to stay inside a human hamster wheel.
Contestants will free fall from a 300 foot building, splatter bugs on their face like a windshield, and try not to fall from a rotating beam.
A celebrity edition features Penn and Teller, Natasha Henstridge, Barry Williams, Matt Cedeno, Gena Lee Nolin and Keshia Knight Pulliam.
Models Episode - Players will 8free themselves from hanging in chains, pull alligator tails, and crawl between two helicopters with only a rope.
Previous winners return to ride bicycles on a 6-inch-wide beam balanced between two speeding trucks and drink juice made from tomato horn worms.
Four pairs of best friends play a game of "Fear Factor chicken" in which contestants drive cars toward each other, only to have them flipped before they can collide.
Contestants must complete four stunts; players are pierced with long needles, and they eat cheese crawling with maggots.
Male contestants must identify disgusting items, then eat any they guess incorrectly; female contestants must retrieve dead feeder mice with their mouths while swimming in a vat of dead rodents.

For the first stunt, contestants ride a raft behind a speedboat. They climb a rope hanging from a helicopter and release 6 flags before dropping 20 feet into the water. If contestants completed this stunt, they would win $1,000.

In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing on opposite platforms suspended 100 feet in the air. Contestants will have to siphon gross fluid (worms, crickets, cow parts, pig parts etc) out of 4 containers and into a large funnel.
Contestants must drop out of a helicopter and race to pick up flags while swimming, and participate in a gross pot luck dinner. Then they must make their way through an airborne greasy maze.
Contestants get dragged by a horse, rest in a pit of rats and crawl on a car suspended 150 feet in the air.
Contestants must stand on a truck as it drives through a tunnel, hit targets to avoid eating bugs, and dodge eing flipped by a tractor.
Perched on the hood of a car suspended 100 feet high by a giant electric magnet, contestants must switch it off, sending themselves and the vehicle plummeting toward a target on the ground.
Players must wedge themselves between two walls to avoid falling, eat live snails, and jump cars into trucks.
Thousands of bees swarm all over contestants. Host: Joe Rogan.
Contestants descend into a pit filled with more than 2,000 scorpions.
Couples Episode - Contestants brave a gross dunk tank and slalom to grab flags from a speeding helicopter
Contestants must consume balut -- eggs containing partially developed duck embryos -- as well as liquefied liver and dead silk worms in brine.
Contestants must hold their breath in a leech-filled coffin and drive a motorcycle off a 100-foot cliff in hopes of winning $1 million.
Four sets of twins compete for $50,000 as they are electric shocked
